SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading 11.2.1 Intensive Reading: Reading with Technology, part of SPORTS - APPRECIATING TALENTS Suggested Vocabulary: competition, cheer, score, a in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade five General.

Key inquiry question: Why is it important to relate what you read to real life experiences? 2. What digital resources can you use in your reading?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:
